subject.title: feat: a best-in-class Usage & Spend dashboard — model/tool views, accurate spend, token activity heatmap

question: Should CodexBar ship a dashboard that reattributes cross-provider usage by inferred billing vendor and presents merged model/tool/subscription totals as a first-class product surface?
rationale: This is a user-facing accounting policy, not a mechanical defect: reasonable implementations differ on whether the issuing tool, configured endpoint vendor, or billed provider is authoritative when local records are incomplete or overlapping.

options.title: Approve the attribution contract
options.body: Accept the model/tool/subscription dashboard direction, provided the merge review confirms source-specific provenance, partial-coverage disclosure, and local-scanner correctness.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Keep model and tool history but defer inferred subscription billing attribution until maintainers define a smaller, explicit contract.

options.title: Pause this feature direction
options.body: Do not add cross-provider aggregation until product ownership and display semantics are agreed in the linked design discussion.

recommendation.title: Approve the attribution contract
recommendation.body: Accept the model/tool/subscription dashboard direction, provided the merge review confirms source-specific provenance, partial-coverage disclosure, and local-scanner correctness.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is product direction for a repository-wide user-facing dashboard, not authorship of an isolated implementation file.
